domain_focus: MAVEN-ERE: exhaustive broad event mention inventory first; precision-oriented CAUSE/PRECONDITION extraction second.
abstraction_level: Layer 1 maximizes exact source event-trigger recall including nominal/state events; Layer 2 requires verified causal dependence before subtype.
population_policy: Extract all source-grounded event mentions. A deterministic source-token rescue pool is LLM-verified after the generative pass; keep mentions independent for recall. Relation existence uses two independent gates. Gold/coreference IDs remain unavailable until post-L12 evaluation.
event_modeling_preference: Use the shortest complete exact trigger; retain genuine multi-token predicates such as took place; do not conflate entity mentions with events.

negative_examples.text: A relation inferred only from world knowledge with no document support.
